js-first-divisible.wrong-round: function firstDivisible(numbers,divisor){let i=0;while(i<numbers.length){const v=numbers[i++];if(v%divisor===0)return Math.abs(v);}return null;}

js-join-with-for-of.alternative: function joinWords(words,separator){let out="",position=0;for(const word of words){if(position++)out+=separator;out+=word;}return out;}
js-join-with-for-of.wrong-trim: function joinWords(words,separator){let out="",first=true;for(const word of words){if(!first)out+=separator;out+=word.trim();first=false;}return out;}
js-join-with-for-of.wrong-separator: function joinWords(words,separator){let out="",first=true;for(const word of words){if(!first)out+=separator.slice(0,3);out+=word;first=false;}return out;}

js-number-items.alternative: function numberItems(items){const out=[];for(const [i,item] of items.entries())out.push(String(i+1)+". "+item);return out;}
js-number-items.wrong-trim: function numberItems(items){const out=[];for(const [i,item] of items.entries())out.push(`${i+1}. ${String(item).trim()}`);return out;}
